passage: 【公開抄録の要約】健常者を対象とする自己研究の限界を指摘し、神経心理学的障害の症例で補う。心停止後の低酸素による重度の健忘の患者 D.B. を提示する。D.B. は個人的過去の想起と一般的事実の想起が大きく損なわれながら、性格特性についての自己知識は年齢を合わせた健常対照と同程度に信頼でき正確だった。自己知識はエピソード記憶や意味記憶の障害から独立に保たれる可能性を示す。
context: 神経心理学的症例による自己知識と記憶の解離。特性自己知識がエピソード想起や意味的個人事実から独立に保たれるかを、D.B. の評定の信頼性と正確さで検討する。
source_note: 情報利得：HYP-20261120-b18876（思考・記憶・核自己・自伝的自己の四層解離説）の層の区別と HYP-20261121-c27e89（三関係軸説）の取り込み・出所・供給の区別を比較する。特性自己知識が想起から独立に保たれるなら、個別の記憶が自己の材料になる仕事は想起の有無だけで決まらない。

passage: 【公開抄録の要約】自己を単一の単位的な実体、すなわち思い出し選び考え計画し感じる一つの私として捉える暗黙の信念が、自己の理解を難しくしていると論じる。主として神経心理学的参加者を対象とする研究を概観し、エピソード想起のような自己知識の一部が損なわれても、意味的な特性の要約はおおむね保たれることを示す。単一で統一された私ではなく、相互に関係しつつ機能的に独立した諸系の集合として自己を捉えることを提案する。

title: Frequency, characteristics and functions of future-oriented thoughts in daily life

source.title: Frequency, characteristics and functions of future-oriented thoughts in daily life
source.version_note: Applied Cognitive Psychology 25(1):96-103. DOI 10.1002/acp.1647. 収蔵前に three_gates.py --check-source で DOI・題名・著者と年を照合し、CLEAR を確認した。出版社公開抄録で書誌と要旨を照合。原著本文の全文通読はしていない。

passage: 【公開抄録の要約】日常生活で未来志向の思考がどれほど現れ、どんな性質と機能を持つかを、自然な場面で記録して検討した。未来志向の思考は日常生活で頻繁に現れ、抽象的な程度の異なる表象形式をとり、仕事や関係などの多様な主題を含み、行動計画や意思決定などの多様な機能を果たす。時間距離によって機能と性質が異なり、近い未来の思考は具体的で行動計画に結びつきやすく、肯定的な思考は頻繁で具体的で視覚像を伴いやすい。
context: 経験標本法による日常生活の未来思考の頻度・形式・機能。時間距離と情動内容による違いを検討する。
source_note: 情報利得：HYP-20261120-b18876 の未来思考と過去想起の足場共有と、HYP-20261121-c27e89 の供給軸を比較する。未来思考が頻繁で多様な機能を持つなら、思考は記憶の再利用だけでは記述できない。
literary_invitation: 一日に何度も未来を考えている。その思考は、自己の連続を支える仕事をしているのか。

title: Precis of the illusion of conscious will

source.title: Precis of the illusion of conscious will
source.version_note: Behavioral and Brain Sciences 27(5):649-659. DOI 10.1017/s0140525x04000159. PMID 15895616. 収蔵前に three_gates.py --check-source で DOI・題名・著者と年を照合し、AUTHOR_YEAR（同著者・同年の別論文と衝突）を確認した。同一論文の重複はなし。PubMed 公開抄録で書誌と要旨を照合。原著本文の全文通読はしていない。

passage: 【公開抄録の要約】意識的な意志の経験は、行為をしていると感じることである。この感じは多くの行為で生じるが、心や脳や身体で実際に起きていることの真の読み取りとは限らない。感じは誤らされることがある。臨床障害や催眠や自動書記などの現象で、意志なしに行為が起きたり、行為なしに意志が生じたりする。見かけの心的因果の理論を提示する。思考が行為の直前に意識に現れ、行為と一致し、目立つ他の原因を排して現れるとき、意識的な意志を経験し、行為の作者を自分に帰す。意志の経験は、心が自分を解釈する過程から生じる。
context: 意識的な意志の経験と行為の作者帰属。思考と行為の時間的・内容的関係が意志の感じを生むという理論を、臨床例と実験の概観で検討する。
source_note: 情報利得：HYP-20261120-b18876 の所有割り当てと現在の結節と、HYP-20261121-c27e89 の出所確定軸を比較する。意志の感じが思考の解釈から生じるなら、個別の思考は行為の原因の直接の窓ではない。
literary_invitation: 自分がやったと感じることと、実際に自分が原因だったことは、同じことなのか。
scope_note: 公開抄録の照合まで。原著本文の全文通読はしていない。理論の要約であり、自由意志の存在や不在を決めるものではなく、AI の主観的経験を直接証明しない。

title: Human volition: towards a neuroscience of will

source.title: Human volition: towards a neuroscience of will
source.version_note: Nature Reviews Neuroscience 9(12):934-946. DOI 10.1038/nrn2497. PMID 19020512. 収蔵前に three_gates.py --check-source で DOI・題名・著者と年を照合し、AUTHOR_YEAR（同著者・同年の別論文と衝突）を確認した。同一論文の重複はなし。PubMed 公開抄録で書誌と要旨を照合。原著本文の全文通読はしていない。

passage: 【公開抄録の要約】自発的な行為の能力は人間性にとって本質的と見なされるが、神経科学や行動主義心理学はその仕組みが不明なため非科学的としてきた。新しい研究は、補足運動前野や前頭前野や頭頂皮質を含む脳領域の網が自発的な行為を支えることを特定した。これらの領域は今後の行為の情報を生み、意図して自分の行為を制御しているという意識的な経験も生じさせる。意志は、行為するかどうか、何の行為をするか、いつ行為をするかについての連続した決定からなる。神経科学の説明は個人的責任の議論に情報を与えうる。
context: 総説。自発的な行為の神経網と、意図や制御の意識的な経験の関係を、行為するかどうか・何をするか・いつするかという決定の連続として整理する。
source_note: 情報利得：HYP-20261120-b18876 の現在の結節と所有割り当てと、HYP-20261121-c27e89 の出所確定軸を比較する。意志が連続した決定の束なら、個別の思考は単一の帰属工程では記述できない。
literary_invitation: やるかどうかの決定と、何をやるかの決定と、いつやるかの決定は、一つの意志か、それとも束か。
scope_note: 公開抄録の照合まで。原著本文の全文通読はしていない。総説であり新しい一次データは提示しない。責任の議論への含意は解釈の範囲であり、AI の主観的経験を直接証明しない。

title: Functional neuroanatomy of remote episodic, semantic and spatial memory: a unified account based on multiple trace theory

source.title: Functional neuroanatomy of remote episodic, semantic and spatial memory: a unified account based on multiple trace theory
source.version_note: Journal of Anatomy 207(1):35-66. DOI 10.1111/j.1469-7580.2005.00421.x. PMID 16011544. PMCID PMC1571502. 収蔵前に three_gates.py --check-source で DOI・題名・著者と年を照合し、AUTHOR_YEAR（同著者・同年の別論文と衝突）を確認した。同一論文の重複はなし。PubMed 公開抄録で書誌と要旨を照合。原著本文の全文通読はしていない。

passage: 【公開抄録の要約】損傷と神経画像の証拠を概観し、海馬や他の構造が最近の記憶と遠い記憶の保持と想起に果たす役割を検討する。エピソード記憶と意味記憶と空間記憶を区別する。細かく鮮明な自伝的記憶の保持と想起は、出来事がいつ起きたかによらず海馬系に依存する。意味記憶はしばらく海馬の寄与を受けてから海馬なしに想起できるようになる。意味記憶にもエピソード的な要素が残り、海馬への依存が続くことがある。経験的に細かな空間記憶と概略的な空間記憶も同様に区別できる。証拠は伝統的な統合モデルより多重痕跡理論を支持する。
context: 総説。遠い自伝的記憶と意味記憶と空間記憶の海馬への依存の違いを、損傷研究と神経画像研究の概観で整理する。

passage: This research concerns the development of children's understanding of representational change and its relation to other cognitive developments. Children were shown deceptive objects, and the true nature of the objects was then revealed. Children were then asked what they thought the object was when they first saw it, testing their understanding of representational change; what another child would think the object was, testing their understanding of false belief; and what the object looked like and really was, testing their understanding of the appearance-reality distinction. Most 3-year-olds answered the representational change question incorrectly. Most 5-year-olds did not make this error. Children's performance on the representational change question was poorer than their performance on the false-belief question. There were correlations between performance on all 3 tasks. Apparently children begin to be able to consider alternative representations of the same object at about age 4.

passage: Numerous studies show that children's language ability is related to false-belief understanding. However, there is considerable variation in the size of the correlation reported. Using data from 104 studies (N=8,891), this meta-analysis determines the strength of the relation in children under age 7 and examines moderators that may account for the variability across studies--including aspect of language ability assessed, type of false-belief task used, and direction of effect. The results indicate a moderate to large effect size overall that remains significant when age is controlled. Receptive vocabulary measures had weaker relations than measures of general language. Stronger effects were found from earlier language to later false belief than the reverse. Significant differences were not found among types of false-belief task.

passage:
Following recording, a gaze replay AVI showing the exact location of the child's gaze was exported at 25 fps from the Clearview programme. We took two measures of action anticipation. As our principal measure, we coded the location of the first saccade following the illumination of the windows. As all children were focused on the actor who had just turned around at this point, a clearly discernable saccade to one of the windows was available for every child who met the criterion for inclusion in the analysis. 17 out of 20 infants gazed towards the correct window following illumination ( _p_ = .003, _prep_ = .982, two-choice binomial test, two-tailed). There was no difference between performance on the two false-belief conditions with 9/10 infants gazing correctly to the right-hand door on the false-belief 1 condition and 8/10 infants gazing correctly to the left-hand door on the false-belief 2 condition ( _P_ = .5, one-tailed Fisher's exact test). Secondly, we coded the amount of time spent focused on each window for each child. As infants were familiarized to a delay of 1750 ms between the onset of illumination and the opening of a window, we coded only the first 1750 ms after onset of illumination on the test trial. Infants spent almost twice as long focusing on the correct window than the incorrect window: an average of 956 ms and 496 ms respectively. A repeated measures ANOVA with location as a within-subjects factor and condition (FB1 vs. FB2) as a between subjects factor confirmed that infants looked significantly longer towards the correct window than the incorrect window ( _F_ (1, 18) =

5.21, _p_ = .035, _prep_ = .901, ηp2 = .22,). The interaction between window and condition was not significant.

passage: Theory of mind is claimed to develop universally among humans across cultures with vastly different folk psychologies. However, in the attempt to test and confirm a claim of universality, individual studies have been limited by small sample sizes, sample specificities, and an overwhelming focus on Anglo-European children. The current meta-analysis of children's false-belief performance provides the most comprehensive examination to date of theory-of-mind development in a population of non-Western children speaking non-Indo-European languages (i.e., Mandarin and Cantonese). The meta-analysis consisted of 196 Chinese conditions (127 from mainland China and 69 from Hong Kong), representing responses from more than 3,000 children, compared with 155 similar North American conditions (83 conditions from the United States and 72 conditions from Canada). The findings show parallel developmental trajectories of false-belief understanding for children in China and North America coupled with significant differences in the timing of development across communities--children's false-belief performance varied across different locales by as much as 2 or more years. These data support the importance of both universal trajectories and specific experiential factors in the development of theory of mind.

passage: Recently, several studies have claimed that soon after their first birthday infants understand others' false beliefs. However, some have questioned these findings based on criticisms of the looking-time paradigms used. Here we report a new paradigm to test false belief understanding in infants using a more active behavioral response: helping. Specifically, the task was for infants to help an adult achieve his goal – but to determine that goal infants had to take into account what the adult believed (i.e., whether or not he falsely believed there was a toy inside a box). Results showed that by 18 months of age infants successfully took into account the adult's belief in the process of attempting to determine his goal. Results for 16-month-olds were in the same direction but less clear. These results represent by far the youngest age of false belief understanding in a task with an active behavioral measure.

passage: Human social interactions crucially depend on the ability to represent other agents' beliefs even when these contradict our own beliefs, leading to the potentially complex problem of simultaneously holding two conflicting representations in mind. Here, we show that adults and 7-month-olds automatically encode others' beliefs, and that, surprisingly, others' beliefs have similar effects as the participants' own beliefs. In a visual object detection task, participants' beliefs and the beliefs of an agent (whose beliefs were irrelevant to performing the task) both modulated adults' reaction times and infants' looking times. Moreover, the agent's beliefs influenced participants' behavior even after the agent had left the scene, suggesting that participants computed the agent's beliefs online and sustained them, possibly for future predictions about the agent's behavior. Hence, the mere presence of an agent automatically triggers powerful processes of belief computation that may be part of a "social sense" crucial to human societies.

passage: Recently, theory-of-mind research has been revolutionized by findings from novel implicit tasks suggesting that at least some aspects of false-belief reasoning develop earlier in ontogeny than previously assumed and operate automatically throughout adulthood. Although these findings are the empirical basis for far-reaching theories, systematic replications are still missing. This article reports a preregistered large-scale attempt to replicate four influential anticipatory-looking implicit theory-of-mind tasks using original stimuli and procedures. Results showed that only one of the four paradigms was reliably replicated. A second set of studies revealed, further, that this one paradigm was no longer replicated once confounds were removed, which calls its validity into question. There were also no correlations between paradigms, and thus, no evidence for their convergent validity. In conclusion, findings from anticipatory-looking false-belief paradigms seem less reliable and valid than previously assumed, thus limiting the conclusions that can be drawn from them.
